name: Mai-chan wa Ninkatsuchuu
source:
Since walking into the wrong sort of AV club, Mai-chan has been thoroughly knocked up.

She learned to be a mazo slave before, and her breaking in continues as her belly grows.
Mai-chan, congratulations! You're glowing!
When's the baby due?

Wait... who's the father?
